newsitem.title: USA: Javelin signs distribution pact with Riva.
newsitem.headline: Javelin signs distribution pact with Riva.

text.p: Javelin Systems Inc Monday said on Monday it agreed to allow Riva Electronics Ltd, a unit of Riva Group Plc, distribute of its line of point-of-sale computers, designed primarily for the foodservice and hospitality industries.

British-based Riva, one of the three largest distributors to the point-of-sale market in Europe, said it was granted exclusive distribution rights in Britain, Australia and New Zealand, and non-exclusive rights in other parts of Europe.

Under the terms of the multiyear agreement, Riva must purchase a minimum of about $2.3 million in Javelin computers during the first 12 months in order to retain exclusive distribution rights. Riva is not obligated to purchase any minimum quantities, however.
